title: An ultra-Orthodox community in Israel has its own Hill

tellings.quote: golden and they live in an very Ultra Orthodox community in Israel they have their own Hill

plain: Children in an ultra-Orthodox community in Israel are said to have their own "Hill." That is the name used in the documentary The Telepathy Tapes for a place the children it follows, who are said to read minds, describe meeting in their minds. The documentary maker Ky Dickens tells Michels this as something she heard from members of the Golden family, Arthur Golden and Ben Golden. If true, the experience would be shared by children far apart.
